    Spotted enemies (seen by you or an ally, or just fired near your side) get a red marker with their range, a red arrow at the screen edge when off-screen and a red square on the minimap; a red arc around the crosshair points to whoever just hit you. The small circle shows where your gun is really pointed; over an enemy it turns green (shell gets through), yellow (maybe), red (no) or grey (ricochet). Angle your front armour, hit enemy sides & rear, shoot tracks to immobilise. Penetrations knock out crew: lose all but one and the tank is lost. APHE wrecks crews, AP gets through thicker plate, HE is for open-topped vehicles. Lock-on rockets (Hornet R-5 tank, P-51D Kestrel plane): keep an enemy tank or aircraft inside the dashed circle; the yellow box closes in and turns red when LOCKED, then press R and the rocket steers itself to it.
    
    
    Aircraft spawn in the air behind your base. Point the mouse where you want to go and the plane follows. There are no flight assists: if you fly slow or pull too hard you will stall, and nothing pulls you out of a dive, so watch the IAS and AGL readouts and the STALL and PULL UP warnings. Set your speed with W/S or the 1–4 presets; the throttle bar shows the setting, the blue tick the speed it settles at and the red tick the stall speed. The cross is where your guns point; lead moving targets using the lead marker. The diamond on the ground is where a bomb would land. The P-51D Kestrel's rockets lock on by themselves: hold an enemy plane or tank inside the dashed circle until the box turns red, then press R.
